# Smart Scroll

> Smart Scroll turns mindless scrolling into focused learning. Users watch short educational videos, take AI-generated quizzes on what they've watched, earn XP, and build learning streaks.

Smart Scroll is a short-form educational video platform. Creators upload bite-sized lessons across subjects like Math, Science, History, Psychology, Money, Technology, ELA, SAT Prep, Music, and Philosophy. Viewers scroll through a personalized feed, hit quiz checkpoints, and track their progress through learning paths.
